first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: gray head-and-chest bust
entities.identification: A dark gray, hairless head-and-chest bust consisting of a head, long neck, and narrow shoulder cross-section, with a smooth surface and cool-toned highlights.

entities.name: white two-tier rotating platform
entities.identification: A wide, flattened oval, white two-tier base below the bust, with a narrow black gap between the tiers and a black circular control area on the front of the base.

entities.name: white rectangular backdrop panel
entities.identification: A large, bright white rectangular panel behind the bust; its top edge and image-left and image-right edges are visible, while its lower edge is partially occluded by foreground equipment.

entities.name: dark gray studio wall
entities.identification: A large dark gray wall surface surrounding the white rectangular backdrop panel, with slight mottled color variation on its surface.

entities.name: light-colored textured tabletop
entities.identification: A light gray-white horizontal tabletop supporting the rotating platform, with irregular gray textured lines on its surface.

entities.name: bar-shaped light fixture at the top
entities.identification: A slender, dark-colored lamp head extending horizontally and diagonally across the upper part of the image, with metallic reflections; its right end connects to a black joint and a partially visible light-colored curved connecting section.

entities.name: black light stand on the right
entities.identification: A black vertical stand to the image-right of the backdrop panel, with clamps, knobs, and horizontal joints, and a cable hanging down alongside it.

entities.name: bar graphic below “Ecommerce”
entities.identification: An overall overlay graphic at the bottom of the image containing the white text “Ecommerce,” a black translucent horizontal bar, and a white border.
